**General**
- Fixes for many reported crashes
- Fixed the global palette always resetting to 'Existing/Global' on startup
- [Linux] Fixed an issue where the deprecated `~/.slade3` config directory was still being created on startup
- Fixed an error on 'Save As' overwriting an archive that has been previously opened

**Game Formats & Features**
- Highlighting support for `final` and `transient` ZScript keywords
- Added support for `NUGHUD` entries (thanks @wolfmanfp)
- Added support for Odamex `HORDEDEF` and `SPREEDEF` text entries (thanks @electricbrass)
- Added support for loading and saving SiN Reloaded archives (thanks @Paril)
- Added support for loading Daikatana pak archives with compression (thanks @Paril)
	- As the format is not easy to distinguish from regular pak archives, a new cvar `pak_enable_daikatana` was added to enable it
- Fixed loading of very large archive files (eg. olremaster1.lab from Outlaws Remastered)
- Fixed loading of Quake .bsp archives
- Fixed parsing of DECORATE `//$` editor comments
- Fixed recognition of JPEG images without a JFIF or Exif header (thanks @wolfmanfp)

**Resource Editor**
- The translation editor dialog can now be resized
- Fixed map preview in pk3 not accounting for non-doom format maps
- Fixed slowness opening large data entries with row padding enabled
- [Windows] Fixed exporting as PNG if the entry name contains invalid filename characters

**Texture Editor**
- The texture editor has been given an overhaul:
	- Improved UI with a simpler layout and less wasted space
	- Instead of one tab per `TEXTUREx`, the texture list is now shown as a tree view. Selecting a `TEXTUREx` root item in the tree displays all textures in that list in a browser view, double-clicking a texture in the browser will open it in the editor
	- The patch table (`PNAMES`) is now displayed as a sidebar tab on the right instead of its own full tab, along with a small preview and list of textures the selected patch is used in. Patches can be dragged from the patch list directly on to the current texture, and double-clicking one of the 'used-in' textures will open that texture in the editor
	- Full undo+redo support

**Map Editor**
- Added back some action specials that were missed with the migration to JSON format (eg. Sector_SetColor)
- Sidedef compression now correctly ignores lines with a special or id
- Fixed some issues with locking the mouse cursor during mouselook
- Fixed map entries being written in the wrong order when saving a map
- Fixed duplication of 'extra' map entries on save (eg. `DIALOGUE`)
- Fixed issues with the 'clean' colour configuration
- Fixed the 3d mode info overlay not immediately updating when toggled
- Fixed loading of Doom64 maps with sidedef compression
- Fixed an issue where the sky texture could change to a random image in 3d mode
- Fixed actor scale not applying to sprites in 3d mode
- Fixed the 'Enter 3d mode at cursor' feature not immediately updating the 3d view
